summary: This note describes "Watching Movies," a 2013 song by American hip hop artist Mac Miller, released as the second single from his second studio album "Watching Movies with the Sound Off." It credits production by Sap and by Miller under the alias Larry Fisherman. The song peaked at number 33 on the US Billboard Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs chart, and a music video was made for it.
one_line: Mac Miller's 2013 single "Watching Movies" from the album "Watching Movies with the Sound Off", produced by Sap and Larry Fisherman.
key_facts: "Watching Movies" is a song by American hip hop recording artist Mac Miller.
The song was released on May 25, 2013.
"Watching Movies" was the second single from Mac Miller's second studio album "Watching Movies with the Sound Off".
The song was produced by Sap, who also produced Miller's debut single "Donald Trump".
The song was also produced by Miller under the alias Larry Fisherman.
"Watching Movies" peaked at number 33 on the US Billboard Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs chart.
A music video for the single was created by Rex Arrow and Larry Fisherman.
The music video features Miller succumbing to the materials associated with hip-hop.
